name: HOMER
summary: A remote object selection and manipulation technique that combines ray-based selection with hand-centered manipulation after the object is grabbed.
howItWorks: Point a ray at a remote object and confirm the grab. Once selected, the object is attached to the user's virtual hand so it can be moved and manipulated through hand or controller motion.
advantages: Grabbing and manipulating remote objects in immersive virtual environments without requiring the user to physically travel to the object.
limitations: The transition from ray-based selection to hand-centered manipulation can require practice, and remote manipulation may reduce precision compared with direct nearby manipulation.
